title: RF metrics not signaled in DIO: per-neighbor EMA SNR (alpha=1/4) and packet loss rate DIO option absent (CCP-16)
description:
Req R-02-017 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5, MUST): 'ASSIGNED_SF and RF metrics (per-neighbor EMA SNR with alpha=1/4, packet loss rate) MUST be signaled in DIO per CCP-16.'

Classification: not-implemented (RF-metrics half; ASSIGNED_SF half exists in Rust only).
Evidence: no EMA-SNR or loss-rate DIO option in any implementation (search negative across rust/lichen-rpl, python/src/lichen, lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl). Only TLV found is ASSIGNED_SF [0x14,1,sf] (rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs:140-153).

Suggested placement: RPL DIO option registry entry (see spec/09-packets-timing.md registry) + encode in rust/lichen-rpl, C rpl, python RPL model; define CBOR/TLV encoding and vectors.
